manual.introduction.line2: Greetings and welcome to Immersive Engineering.{0}
manual.introduction.line3: The following notes and guides will showcase the most recent technology available in the modern combined worlds.{0}
manual.introduction.line4: However, certain pieces of science may be so weird, that this manual can not yet explain them. In traveling the worlds, certain Eureka-moments may lead to new pages being added to the manual, though this will be a rare exception.{0}
manual.introduction.line5: All engineering in the following chapters is built around the concept of pre-computing transfer of energy. The energy used by the machines is Forge Energy, a trait shared with many other generation methods currently available.{0}
manual.introduction.line6: Many machines are {0}multiblock machines{1}, formed with the {2}Engineer's Hammer{3}.{4}
manual.introduction.line7: All the information needed to use the technology is contained within, so venture boldly forth!
